title: Hussain no gham
body:
Hussain no gham
<<MINI>>
(Hussain no gham sheher sheher che. Hussain matam, gali gali che) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(A ghamme dilme, basave ene) x2 Dua-e-Zehra, maligayi che
(Hawe to duniya amone samje, hawe to duniya amone jane) x2 Amara aka hussain mawla, amara mawla, ali ali che
(Ho reno badro, ohad ne khandaq. Narai kheibar, ni kehrahi che) x2 Bahadori maa Ali na same batawo koni, barabari che
(Furat upar, kari ne kabzo. Na bundh pani, jene pidho) x2 Wafaa-e-Abbas, saw wafaa che, furat sajda, kari rahi che
<<DIVIDER>>
(Jawaan-e-Akbar, na dil thi barchi. Ne kadhi mawla rarirea che) x2 Salaam sabre Hussain tamne, jigar ma barchi, rahi gayi che
(Nihari Asghar, ne roze mehshar. Ajab nathi khud, khuda kahe pan) x2 Rubab tari matta ki keemat, behesht puri adhuri they che
(Jarak dhemee thi bolo zainab, jarak dhemee jagaro zainab) x2 Ke lash maidan ma nihari sakina bibi, dari gayi che.
(Mari jo zindan thi rihaai, Ali ni puttri rari ne boli) x2 Ke mara bhai ni ik nishani, aa kaid khana rahi gayi che
<<MINI>>
(Hussain no gham sheher sheher che. Hussain matam, gali gali che) x2
